tbos.label: TBOS
tbos.commands:
hostname
echo "=== TBOS Service Status ==="
systemctl status tbos
echo "=== Disk Usage ==="
df -h
echo "=== Network Interfaces ==="
ip a
date
echo "End Of Validation"

kafka.label: KAFKA
kafka.commands:
hostname
echo "=== Kafka Service Status ==="
systemctl status kafka
systemctl status zookeeper
echo "=== Disk Usage ==="
df -h
echo "=== Java Version ==="
java -version
date
echo "End Of Validation"

worker.label: WORKER
worker.commands:
hostname
echo "=== Docker Containers ==="
docker ps -a
echo "=== Resource Usage ==="
free -m
df -h
date
echo "End Of Validation"
